item.title: Crawl4AI Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Crawl Hooks (CVE-2026-26216)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — web · CVE-2026-26216 / GHSA-5882-5rx9-xgxp. Status: PoC (complete end-to-end exploit against the bundled reproduction; no run against the real Crawl4AI image is documented upstream). Affects: Crawl4AI — open-source LLM-friendly crawler/scraper, Docker API server (POST /crawl endpoint). Tags: crawl4ai, code-injection, CWE-94, python, sandbox-escape, builtins-allowlist, unauthenticated, rce, docker, llm-tooling.
